production_notes: The opening rain-window clip returns in reverse at the end to create a soft visual loop.
The procedural score emphasizes filtered ambience; add a platform-native atmospheric track only after upload.
Preserve the silent master for platforms where rain texture works better without music.
Curated Pexels material must not be described as personally filmed.
Human visual and audio approval is required before scheduling.

instagram.caption: Rain, empty streets, and lights reflected where they were never meant to be. Cities become honest after midnight.
instagram.music_search: In Instagram or Edits, search for dark ambient rain, minimal nocturnal pulse, or moody city sound; keep it understated.
instagram.music_reuse_policy: Reuse on Facebook only when Meta confirms clearance for both placements.
instagram.schedule_notes: Instagram Reel; use AFTER THE RAIN as the dark cinematic cover.

checklist: Open both MP4 masters, cover, and contact sheet; confirm the rain-window return makes the loop feel intentional.
Confirm source pages, creators, license evidence, and SHA-256 hashes in manifest.json.
Confirm 1080 x 1920, H.264, 10-second duration, and audio-stream checks passed.
Listen once with the procedural score and once silent; choose the stronger base per platform.
Confirm there is no watermark, false personal-filming claim, or unlicensed external audio.
Add platform music natively and record the actual track in this file.
Verify caption, CTA, hashtags, thumbnail, date, time zone, and preview before scheduling.
